title: Final Farewell
subtitle: The Final Departure
description: Conclude the PHOBOSIA expedition: acknowledge Selina's in-transit message from Deimosian Outpost to PHOBOSIA Outpost, write a personal expedition log, prepare the existing EVA suit, enter the assigned rover, travel the 200-metre departure route, and complete the final cinematic.

missionZones.purpose: Receive Selina's incoming message and write the final personal expedition log at the existing main console.
Prepare the existing EVA suit at its registered preparation interaction.
Enter the existing assigned rover and complete the 200-metre departure route.

interfaces.location: Existing Mission Control Main Operations Console
interfaces.purpose: Acknowledge Selina's message and submit the player-authored final expedition log.
Enter the assigned rover and follow the departure route.

tasks.title: Acknowledge Selina's Incoming Message
tasks.objective: Read and acknowledge Selina's message. She departed Deimosian Outpost and remains in transit to PHOBOSIA Outpost for several hours.
tasks.completionCondition: The player acknowledges the persisted incoming message.

tasks.title: Write the Final Expedition Log
tasks.objective: Write and submit a personal reflection on the observations, discoveries, experiences and records of SOL 1 through SOL 10.
tasks.completionCondition: A non-empty player-authored log is persisted.

tasks.title: Prepare for Departure
tasks.objective: Collect or equip the existing EVA suit using its registered interaction.
tasks.completionCondition: The existing EVA suit is active after interaction at the existing preparation point.

tasks.title: Enter the Assigned Vehicle
tasks.objective: Enter the existing assigned Terrain Rover using its normal interaction.
tasks.completionCondition: The existing rover controller confirms successful entry.

tasks.title: Follow the Departure Route
tasks.objective: Drive approximately 200 metres along the configured visible route beam using actual rover movement.
tasks.completionCondition: The assigned rover has travelled 200 metres along the configured route.

tasks.title: Final Departure
tasks.objective: Watch the mandatory fullscreen final cinematic.
tasks.completionCondition: The final video element's ended event fires successfully.

missionCompletion.completionCondition: Mark campaign complete only after SOL11_FINAL_VIDEO_ENDED.
